6c.repair_note: art10 and art47 failed this run to a Qwen3 thinking-mode repetition loop (~62k output tokens each, filling the 65,536 context; the review call then 400'd). Both were re-extracted on 2026-08-24 under experiment 'qwen-loop-fix': art10 recovered on a re-run alone (different vLLM batch shape), art47 needed VLLM_SEED=4242. Their graphs are in this variant's tree and these metrics were recomputed over all 80 articles; the token total covers the original 78 only, so this run's spend is a floor.
